facts.fact: UM6P formally opened its Benguerir Data Center, built with OCP Group, which also houses managed cloud services provider Atlas Cloud Services (the document gives 'published' date as the opening date; it does not say the centre rents capacity to others beyond hosting Atlas).
The Benguerir Data Center, now open, is described as Tier IV Design certified (design certification, 5MW IT load; certifier not named in the text).
